dd_wls_Action.description: Represents an action taken post evaluation

action.description: An enum representing the type of action to take.

description.description: For debugging purposes a description string can be passed

values.description: Each action defines the values it accepts\supports.

dd_wls_StrEvaluator.description:
Represents a String evaluator
Each evaluator has an ID, a comparison type and a value to compare against.

id.description: The ID is a unique identifier for the evaluator.

cmp.description: The comparison type is used to determine how to compare the value against the evaluator's value.

value.description: The value is the value to compare against.

dd_wls_UNumEvaluator.description:
Represents a String evaluator that can accept multiple values.
Represents an unsigned Numeric evaluator
This evaluator is used for unsigned numeric comparisons.

id.description: Each evaluator has an ID, a comparison type and a value to compare against.

cmp.description: The comparison type is used to determine how to compare the value against the evaluator's value.

value.description: The value is an unsigned long.

dd_wls_NumEvaluator.description:
Represents a signed Numeric evaluator
This evaluator is used for signed numeric comparisons.

id.description: Each evaluator has an ID, a comparison type and a value to compare against.

cmp.description: The comparison type is used to determine how to compare the value against the evaluator's value.

value.description: The value is a signed long.

dd_wls_NodeTypeWrapper.description:
Represents a wrapper for NodeType to allow for union vectors in FlatBuffers.
This is necessary because union vectors are not supported directly in all FlatBuffers implementations :(

dd_wls_CompositeNode.description:
Represents a root node in the policy tree.
It contains a description, a boolean operation (AND, OR, NOT) and a list of child nodes.
The children are wrapped in NodeTypeWrapper to allow for union vectors.

children.description:
At some point we will switch back to; children: [NodeType];
(union vectors are not supported in GO so we are wrapping the table in a table)

dd_wls_EvaluatorNode.description:
Represents a leaf node in the policy tree.
It contains a description and an evaluator.

description.description: The description is used for debugging purposes.

eval.description: The evaluator is a union of different evaluator types (String, Numeric, etc.).

dd_wls_UUID.description:
unfortunetly flatbuffers doesnt support fixed size arrays in go so we can't use it
the solution is to split it into two unsigned longs :(
this should be populate after caculation, and removed prior to verification.

dd_wls_Policy.description:
Represents a policy that contains rules and actions.
The rules are represented as a tree structure where each node can be a leaf (with an evaluator) or a root (with child nodes).

description.description: The policy can have a description for debugging purposes.

rules.description: The rules are represented as a NodeTypeWrapper to allow for union vectors in FlatBuffers.

actions.description: The actions are taken post evaluation of the policy.

id.description:
128 bit UUID represented as 16 raw bytes
this can be used to verify integrity (but NOT origin - this is not a signature!)

version.description: used to track the version number of this policy

dd_wls_Policies.description:
Represents a collection of policies.
This allows for concatenation of policies from different sources.
The policies are stored in a vector of Policy.
This is also the root type of the FlatBuffer schema!!!
